// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// expressions / if / branches
const label = if (ready) {
//            ^^ keyword.control.conditional.ds
    "ready"
} else {
    "waiting"
};

// expressions / if / if let
if (let Some(value) = maybe) {
// <- keyword.control.conditional.ds
    value
} else {
    fallback
}

// expressions / if / ternary
const value = ready ? left : right;
//                  ^ keyword.operator.ternary.ds
